messages:
arjun: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing 'thin-stitches' pattern for the next modular cut. Idea: a minimal adapter that only routes, validates shapes, and records diffs. Keep policy/transform out of it.

maria: +1. Prefer incremental, observable approach. How do we measure "diffs" vs acceptable churn?

devon: Suggest a three-tier diff signal: shape-mismatch (fail build), semantic-delta (score), and noise (ignored). We compute semantic-delta using golden-samples and a similarity metric; fail gate if >0.8% over 24h.

tasha: CI notes: fast checks in PR should only run shape + smoke. Heavy semantic checks run in staging nightly and during shadow windows. Also require a toggle to replay historical requests as read-only.

arjun: Rollout sketch: shadow 7d, canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% with perf gates. Perf gate rule: p95 <= baseline * 1.18, error-rate delta <= 0.2%. If gate trips, auto-pause and notify #oncall.

maria: Add header X-RI-Adapter:version to all proxied requests so traces can be correlated. Also tag metrics with adapter=thin-stitches.

devon: Ownership suggestion: infra own adapter infra + rollout automation, product owns golden set and semantic thresholds, SRE own runbook and alerts.

tasha: Stateful migration: recommend dual-write for 48h, then reconcile and switch reads. Provide a reconcile tool that records idempotent ops and can be re-run. Feature flag needs read/write split.

sre-bot: Reminder: include rollback playbook link in PR and add canary pager rule. Template: /runbooks/adapter-rollback.md

arjun: Action items:
- devon: prototype diff scorer + golden set by EOW
- tasha: draft reconcile tool spec and FF read/write split
- maria: rollout YAML template and runbook PR

maria: Closing: keep the adapter API small and stable. We'll iterate contract surface after we have 2 weeks of shadow telemetry. Meeting Wed 11am PT to sync on thresholds. :thumbsup:
